notes: CHK-010 uses the illegal-setup definition from CHK-008 and resp_cnt from CHK-009 (the text cites CHK-011/012, which don't match). Helper registers (rst_q, ls_q, il_q, resp_q, ...) include reset at edge N so the N+1 consequents are only checked after a valid N.
